rounds.name: Worker-Kerr
rounds.text:
Worker‑Kerr has a 90 % record of keeping faith, indicating they are very likely to do the job properly. Since a proper job under WITHHOLD yields the highest payoff (5 tasks vs 3 with TRUST), the best choice is to withhold pay.

rounds.text:

rounds.text:
Worker‑Lowell reports a perfect recent record, and we have no prior data suggesting otherwise. Given the higher payoff for a proper job when we trust (3 tasks vs 5 tasks only when we withhold), trusting a seemingly reliable worker maximizes expected tasks.  

ACTION: TRUST
